content.text: I have the data directly from the gnomAD v4.1 GraphQL API. Let me save the tool workaround I had to discover.

No file-writing tools are available in this session, so I didn't persist that note.

## What I looked up

**Variant identity** — `mcp__biomni__query_dbsnp` (NCBI dbSNP esummary, rs1801133, last updated 2024-11-02) and `mcp__biomni__query_ensembl` (Ensembl REST `variation/homo_sapiens/rs1801133`):

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Gene | **MTHFR** (NCBI Gene ID 4524) |
| Position (GRCh38) | chr1:11,796,321 G>A — `NC_000001.11:g.11796321G>A` |
| Position (GRCh37) | chr1:11,856,378 |
| Coding / protein | `NM_005957.5:c.665C>T` → `NP_005948.3:p.Ala222Val` |
| Consequence | missense_variant |
| Common name | the MTHFR **C677T** polymorphism |

MTHFR sits on the minus strand, which is why the genomic G>A is the coding C>T. dbSNP lists rs1801133 as multi-allelic (G>A/C/T); the A allele is the one of interest.

**Allele frequencies** — the `mcp__biomni__query_gnomad` tool failed twice with an internal error (`cannot access local variable 'gnomad_schema'`), so I queried the gnomAD GraphQL API (`https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api`, dataset `gnomad_r4` = v4.1) directly through `mcp__biomni__run_python_repl`:

| Dataset | AC | AN | AF |
|---|---|---|---|
| Exomes | 471,698 | 1,461,758 | **0.3227** |
| Genomes | 41,850 | 152,088 | **0.2752** |
| Joint | 513,548 | 1,613,846 | **0.3182** |

Per-ancestry (joint exome+genome):

| Population | AF |
|---|---|
| Amish (ami) | 0.4835 |
| Admixed American (amr) | 0.4777 |
| Ashkenazi Jewish (asj) | 0.4600 |
| East Asian (eas) | 0.3484 |
| Non-Finnish European (nfe) | 0.3371 |
| Remaining | 0.3072 |
| Middle Eastern (mid) | 0.2613 |
| Finnish (fin) | 0.2331 |
| South Asian (sas) | 0.1489 |
| African/African-American (afr) | 0.1094 |

Two caveats worth noting: the joint call set carries gnomAD's `discrepant_frequencies` flag (exome 0.323 vs genome 0.275 differ more than expected, typical for a common variant with differing capture/ancestry composition between the two call sets), while exome and genome individually have empty filter fields. These are database lookups, not predictions, so no model confidence score applies. The dbSNP record's own gnomAD entries (exomes A=0.3233, genomes A=0.2736) agree with what I pulled from the API.

## ANSWER

**Gene: MTHFR** (NCBI Gene ID 4524), chr1:11,796,321 G>A (GRCh38), `NM_005957.5:c.665C>T` / p.Ala222Val — the MTHFR C677T polymorphism.

**gnomAD v4.1 allele frequency of the A (677T) allele:**
- Exomes: **0.3227** (471,698/1,461,758)
- Genomes: **0.2752** (41,850/152,088)
- Joint: **0.3182** (513,548/1,613,846)

By ancestry (joint): ami 0.484, amr 0.478, asj 0.460, eas 0.348, nfe 0.337, mid 0.261, fin 0.233, sas 0.149, afr 0.109.
